title: Area of oblique triangles
sentences: Any triangle's area is half its base times perpendicular height.
Trigonometry supplies that height from two sides and their included angle.
Heron's formula uses only the three side lengths.
Check the triangle inequality first: the sum of any two sides must exceed the third.
A triangle has side lengths 5 m, 5 m, and 6 m.
Side lengths are in meters, so the area is in square meters.
